Movie Night v4: the final layout before it ships

v3 with v2's smoother room header, the card's two additions, and awkward names filtered. Web frames use the app's real classes and CSS from app/globals.css; the cards are the server's own PNGs from lib/mn-share-card-og.tsx; the iPhone frames are drawn to match RoomName.swift. The build is in a local commit, not on main.

From v2The host's Shuffle and pencil sit right beside the name, as v2 had them. The name is a size down (22, the drawer-title size) so all three fit on one line, and there is less space between the title, the name and the seats.
From v3The app's real CSS and seat grid, rounded-square faces (rule 142), faces and name centred as one group, the guest line, and no "Together we're" anywhere.
New on the card"Streaming on Netflix" with its logo, only when the film is streaming. Under the room's name, what the room asked for: "Tense · Funny · Under 2h".
Awkward names filteredRepeated words, a noun stacked on a two-word crowd, "Club" where it doesn't fit, and anything over 28 characters. The full list is at the foot of part b.

Web · the room

iPhone · drawn to match RoomName.swift

The share card · the server's own PNGs

The streaming service is the top one on the US list, so the card says the same thing whoever shares it. Moods are the three most of the room picked, then the length if the host set one.
